title: [ORION-Q MAX-R4E] Prospectively admit QG-derived exact research skills into real quantum method search

nodes.body:
Dependency update: QG-30 is now protected GREEN and may enter MAX-R4E S4 evidence.

Committed parent: `research/extensions/orion-qg/QG30_BULK_COARSE_GRAIN_RESULTS.json` at `645fd92900587ccae551c7d876ae56dffa2950ac`.

Exact transferable lesson for S4/S7:
- full finite-size exact statistic: 715 local-Clifford orbit counts (QG-28);
- asymptotic/bulk exact statistic: 45 bulk-signature counts (QG-30);
- the 45-bin map is provably information-losing for finite defects: 54 one-active profiles exist and 15 bulk signatures split into multiple profiles; first witness `(IIIIXX, IIIIXY)` has the same `(2,2,2,2)` bulk signature but different defect responses.

So MAX-R4E may now test a real **question-conditioned representation skill**: choose the coarsest exact representation licensed for the requested quantity, and refuse to reuse a bulk quotient for finite-size decisions unless a separate information-preservation theorem is available.

This does not itself count as held-out transfer or ORION-Q improvement; it only finalizes the source-skill evidence before the prospective evaluation.

MAX-R4E real-compiler replay calibration is now **GREEN** on draft PR #906 and has committed result custody at `research/extensions/orion-q/MAX_R4E_QG_SKILL_REPLAY_RESULTS.json` commit `3b594a326147e4b943b3f9e525c446987583c33e`.

Protected run: `32569939457`, head `5d6a9b0e40229b0aa3df538b3af874726f8675de`, artifact `9475056190`, artifact SHA256 `7c4aee82794b460d129e7da59df678ac6e69135c5c4174d498535209bb515ec5`.

Earned **replay-only operational value** on three non-TARE real compiler families:
- R6I: re-ran the all-n support-1 theorem successfully. Ordered symplectic frame-pair search cap2/cap1 ratios are exactly `10, 37, 82, 145, 226` for n=2..6. Action: `RESTRICT_TO_PROVED_SUPPORT1`.
- SixLCU: exact minimal K1D1 classifier means the scoped minimal-exact-classifier task can stop before K2/K3 construction: **4,545,400 raw conjunctions** / **530,944 distinct vectors**. Action: `USE_MINIMAL_EXACT_K1D1_PREDICATE`.
- StabPrep: 12 mixed feature cells and `E_floor=43` prove zero error impossible in the frozen vocabulary. For the binary exactness-existence question this certificate can stop before **79,896,607 DFS nodes**, **4,822,968 raw conjunctions**, **617,654 distinct conjunction vectors**, and 9 truncated lattice cells. Action: `REJECT_ZERO_ERROR_IN_FROZEN_VOCAB__ESCALATE_REPRESENTATION`.

Production, independent generic reconstruction, deterministic replay and native ORION-Q authority gate all pass.

This earns only `MAX_R4E_QG_SKILLS_REAL_COMPILER_OPERATIONAL_VALUE_REPLAY=true`. It does **not** earn compiler-general transfer, real MAX-R4 method-search value, broad quantum transfer, real-quantum superiority or novelty. Those remain prospective T2/T3/T4 gates in this issue.

Interpretation: QG is now demonstrably improving ORION-Q as a theorem/certificate-aware research controller in replay—mainly by pruning exact search, stopping impossible representation searches, and selecting the correct representation. Prospective transfer is next.

MAX-R4E source-science has now been converted into the first exact ORION-Q mechanism harness: #908 / draft PR #910.

`MAX-R4E-A` freezes 10 real receipt-derived routing cases and compares:
- B0 conservative-richest (safe but over-detailed),
- B1 aggressive-smallest (compress/proxy first, ignoring authority scope),
- B2 authority-indexed (filter by query/authority contract, then choose minimum burden; otherwise escalate/abstain).

The treatment input excludes family name, case ID, gold route and terminal label. The workflow runs production, independent generic, native ORION-Q, byte-identical replay, plus a self-consistent semantic tamper whose digest is recomputed and which the generic verifier must still reject.

If GREEN, this will justify a narrow statement that QG has improved ORION-Q's **research-control mechanism** on frozen real compiler receipts. It will still keep held-out transfer, autonomous skill selection, general quantum-science improvement and novelty explicitly false. The next lane should only be launched as a stronger held-out/admission test after this calibration clears.

MAX-R4E-A #908 has now earned the first protected **ORION-Q improvement from QG** at the mechanism level.

Committed receipt: `research/extensions/orion-q/MAX_R4EA_AUTHORITY_INDEXED_ROUTER_RESULTS.json` (`962e9d264fe24780291ca8223b8da130ebd6cea9`).

B2 authority-indexed routing was 10/10 correct with zero false authority, zero overcompression and zero avoidable-rich-state use, while capturing 7/7 safe compression opportunities. The conservative richest-state baseline was safe but had 7 avoidable rich-state uses; the aggressive smallest-state baseline produced 5 false-authority uses and 6 overcompressions. Semantic tamper rejection was demonstrated after recomputing the tampered digest.

This advances the MAX-R4E ladder only to **real-receipt research-control mechanism value**. The next required step remains held-out/reminted transfer with protected skill selection; `HELD_OUT_TRANSFER_AUTHORITY`, `AUTONOMOUS_SKILL_SELECTION_AUTHORITY`, `GENERAL_QUANTUM_SCIENCE_IMPROVEMENT` and novelty all remain false.

A genuinely prospective held-out TARE transfer check is now frozen as #914 **before QG-32's protected outcome is read**.

MAX-R4E-A's authority-indexed skill predicts only the action class, not any hidden number/probe set: bulk45 and spectrum54 alone are insufficient for indexed-response identity; joint cheap summaries must be used to localize unresolved classes; acquire only indexed probes needed to separate the residual; authorize an exact minimum only if independently certified; otherwise keep only an upper bound/richer state; preserve every stronger authority false flag.

QG-32 #911/#913 is therefore a legitimate T1 same-domain held-out target. A positive #914 can earn only `MAX_R4EB0_QG_DERIVED_AUTHORITY_SKILL_TRANSFERS_PROSPECTIVELY_TO_HELD_OUT_TARE_QUERY`; compiler-general and broader quantum transfer remain false.

MAX-R4E evidence ladder now has three distinct protected rungs:

1. **Retrospective operational calibration — PR #906:** QG-derived operators avoid large amounts of exact search work on R6I/SixLCU/StabPrep, but this is replay evidence only.
2. **Exact real-receipt control mechanism — #908 / PR #910:** authority-indexed routing was 10/10 correct with zero false authority/overcompression and captured 7/7 safe compression opportunities, beating both richest-state and smallest-state static policies.
3. **Prospective hidden-outcome same-domain transfer — #914 / PR #917:** forecast/scorer/harness were frozen before any accepted QG-32 receipt; after only the immutable target receipt was bound, unchanged adjudication landed on `BORNE_OUT_UPPER_BOUND_ONLY` with zero numerical guesses, zero hidden-outcome dependencies and zero false authority. Committed receipt: `research/extensions/orion-q/MAX_R4EB0_HELDOUT_QG32_RESULTS.json` (`9a9ab3a844a9a681414961ccfdf9ac5a2710275d`).

This earns only `MAX_R4EB0_HELDOUT_TARE_TRANSFER=true` / prospective same-domain action transfer. `MAX_R4E_QG_SKILLS_COMPILER_GENERAL`, real-method search value, broad quantum transfer, autonomous skill-selection authority, general quantum-science improvement and novelty all remain false.

The next ORION-Q positive rung must therefore use a **materially different compiler family** with its target protocol/outcome frozen after the current skill package, not another TARE query remint.
